summary: Frontend-only timezone display regression test for AgriScan /asistencia. Browser context timezone forced to Asia/Karachi (UTC+5) via CDP Emulation.setTimezoneOverride. Logged in as admin, picked Rancho (Delano) + Mayordomo (TEST_Mayordomo) + Trabajo (Cherry) in 'Antes de empezar' modal, opened Check-in view, added a new worker (Gustavo Martín, QR AGW-CDA315B1AD) via Entrada manual (data-testid=manual-worker-select + manual-submit-button). Verified HH:MM in all four display sites.

verifications.backend_iso_present: GET /api/attendance returned check_in='2026-10-05T07:35:49.621772+00:00' (UTC ISO) for new row — confirmed.
verifications.checkin_toast: Toast displayed '✅ Entrada: Gustavo Martín • 12:35' (local HH:MM, UTC was 07:35).
verifications.checkin_list_row: attendance-row-<id> HORA cell displayed '12:35' for Gustavo (UTC 07:35) and '12:35' for Sergio (UTC 07:35). Also pre-existing rows '12:25' (UTC 07:25 Perla) and '12:28' (UTC 07:28 Alex) — all converted.
verifications.hub_view_row: hub-row-<id> displayed '12:25 →' and '12:28 →' matching local Karachi time; hub-checkout-<id> buttons present; no raw UTC substrings found.
verifications.resumen_view: Resumen rendered 'Perla Santos 12:25 → en campo', 'Alex Melo 12:28 → en campo', 'Sergio Santos 12:35 → en campo', 'Gustavo Martín 12:35 → en campo'. Full body text contained zero occurrences of '07:25','07:28','07:35' (UTC) and 6+ occurrences of corresponding local times.
verifications.formatHHMM_bundle: curl of /static/js/bundle.js | grep -c formatHHMM returned 9 (export + consumers). Rebuild confirmed before testing.
verifications.assertion_utc_vs_local: Explicitly asserted UTC substring (iso.substring(11,16)) != displayed local HH:MM — PASSED (07:35 != 12:35).

critical_code_review_comments: Spec said: 'Only check_in_hhmm/check_out_hhmm references remaining are 0 as of this iteration'. grep still shows 4 references to r.check_out_hhmm in /app/frontend/src/pages/Asistencia.jsx (lines 93, 152, 246, 435) used as boolean predicates for 'open shift'. Functionally OK (backend still returns empty string for open shifts), but spec said these should migrate to '!r.check_out' (ISO). Recommend main agent complete the migration for consistency, since legacy check_*_hhmm fields may be removed server-side later.
formatHHMM helper is correct (uses toLocaleTimeString with hour12:false) and is applied at all display sites (lines 113, 114, 460, 936, 938, 1086, 1087, 1189).
action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace remaining 4 `!r.check_out_hhmm` boolean checks with `!r.check_out` in /app/frontend/src/pages/Asistencia.jsx (lines 93, 152, 246, 435) to fully align with spec (currently functional but spec said should be 0 references).
seed_data_creation: Created attendance rows for Sergio Santos (12:35) and Gustavo Martín (12:35) today (2026-10-05) via Entrada manual flow. Pre-existing rows for Perla Santos and Alex Melo unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: formatHHMM timezone fix verified end-to-end in Asia/Karachi (UTC+5). All 4 display sites (Check-in toast, Check-in list row, Resumen row, Hub row) correctly render local HH:MM derived from ISO check_in. Backend unchanged, still returns both ISO (check_in) and legacy check_in_hhmm (UTC). Minor nit: 4 remaining `r.check_out_hhmm` boolean checks in Asistencia.jsx — functionally fine but doesn't match spec claim of zero remaining references.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration bug: UI used check_in_hhmm (which backend formats as UTC %H:%M) causing UTC+5 user to see 07:28 instead of 12:28. Fix in this iteration: formatHHMM(iso) helper converts ISO UTC → user's local TZ via Date.toLocaleTimeString, applied at every display site. Verified by forcing Playwright context TZ to Asia/Karachi and confirming displayed HH:MM differs from iso.substring(11,16) UTC substring.
